metadata.name: cds-core-compatibility-registry
metadata.description: Central record of module pairings known to have been tested together ("tested"), or known NOT to work together despite matching a contract's kind ("unsupported"). Kept as a single file rather than scattered across individual module.yaml documents so composition knowledge about the whole stack stays in one place (see issue #350). A pairing with no entry here is only structurally compatible (same contract kind); it is neither vouched for nor ruled out.
